title: Pompano Beach Amphitheatre
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: The almost 3,000 seat Pompano Beach Amphitheater is one of South Florida’s most beloved venues. The architecturally stunning tensile-fabric covered structure provides shade and protection from sun and rain while maintaining an open-air environment. The elevated concert seating ensures there isn’t a bad seat in the house.
